question: What independent historical locality support exists for the 13 taxa listed by the 2024 Lake Naujan risk assessment?

method.historicalSource: Downloaded the publisher-hosted MBCFI PDF and visually checked the fish tables on PDF pages 150-151 (printed pages 130-131); text extraction was used only as a transcription cross-check.
method.tableHandling: The 2011 tables' full rows, exact presence-cell matrix, and station locations are not reproduced in this artifact. The crosswalk stores only the requested source-name match outcomes and aggregate tributary-match count.
method.taxonomicHandling: Source names are cross-referenced to the already-reviewed 2024 GBIF/Catalog name crosswalk. A backbone match does not re-identify a historical specimen.
method.scope: Historical 2011 survey tables for Naujan Lake, Butas River, and 15 named tributaries. Fish-specific campaign dates and voucher accession identifiers were not verified.

source.title: Naujan Lake National Park Site Assessment and Profile Updating

reuse.sourceNotice: All rights reserved. The profile says reproduction for resale or other commercial purposes requires express written permission.

comparison.countConflict: The profile prose says 20 fish species were documented in Naujan Lake, while its lake/Butas table totals 25 lake and 22 Butas River detections. The source-internal difference remains unresolved.

separateLaterFieldRecord.title: New Locality Record of the Invasive Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus (Weber, 1991) on RAMSAR-listed Lake Naujan, the Philippines
separateLaterFieldRecord.fullTextAccess: Publisher article page returned HTTP 403 in this review environment; an author-uploaded full-text copy was used to check the survey details. Official PJS metadata confirms the article, authors, issue and DOI.
separateLaterFieldRecord.reportedObservation: The authors report one Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus individual unintentionally caught as gill-net bycatch during the survey and identified morphologically by UST researchers. The figure caption identifies Bayani, Lake Naujan; no capture coordinates or museum accession number were found in the reviewed copy.
separateLaterFieldRecord.fisherReports: The authors separately report local fishers' statements about other sightings. These are interview reports, not additional independently documented captures.
inferenceLimits: One fish in a 2023 survey is not an abundance estimate, current-presence confirmation, population estimate, or catchability claim.
The single survey record is not a substitute for the 2011 source table and is not evidence that the species was absent in 2011.
The article-specific reuse license was not verified; do not project its text, image, or transformed observation into the app without rights review.

nextAction: Request the NFRDI 2025-2026 taxon/station tables and reuse terms through the previously prepared unsent inquiry draft; separately ask MBCFI/UPLB to clarify fish-specific survey dates, voucher accession access, the 20-versus-25 lake count, and permission for any future app use. Do not send a request or publish data without explicit authorization and rights review.
